cadenceDiagnosis.method: Separate15s two-native diagnostic only. Hook records in-memory server action receipt/result/duration, client records send times/request IDs; collect by child IPC after the phase. No CPU profiler or per-action file writes; no builds/tests alongside it. Original acceptance gate unchanged.
cadenceDiagnosis.finding: All21 sampled rejections had legal outbound gaps>=120ms, but server action processing gaps compressed to38–99ms. This proves endpoint timing compression; it does NOT distinguish socket queueing from event-loop blockage.
cadenceDiagnosis.next: Measure server event-loop delay and separate snapshot/encoding/periodic-checkpoint work; preserve cadence and durability rather than relax checks or hide errors.
